source.snippet: In my organisation we have the dfs setup for the domain based for our nas servers. The dfs namespace service is getting stopped and we have to start it manually... I want to know the root cause why it is getting stopped and fix the problem.

problem_statement: Windows DFS Namespace service on NAS-backed file servers randomly stops, requiring manual restarts and causing file share outages for the org, with no clear root cause surfaced by standard Windows tooling.
target_segment: Windows sysadmins and IT ops staff at SMB and mid-market companies relying on DFS for shared network storage
notes: Business context clear: organisation with production NAS and DFS. Service outages have direct business cost (employees can't access files). Manual intervention implies no automated recovery. Monitoring and auto-remediation tooling for Windows infrastructure services is a known paid category (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG). Single question but represents a class of recurring Windows infrastructure pain.
